gold_set.sampling: Stratified by lexical overlap plus a dense-only stratum; see scripts/ml/generate-pairs.mjs. Unweighted metrics describe this sample, not the corpus.

method_agreement.note: Label-free. Measures how differently the methods rank the same pairs, NOT how well they do it. Low agreement means the gold labels will actually be able to separate them.

best_f1_operating_point.caveat: Threshold chosen on the same data it is scored on; optimistically biased at this sample size.

weighted_estimate_at_best_f1.note: Inverse-inclusion-probability (Horvitz-Thompson) estimate for the full pair space. This is the corpus-level number; the unweighted ones above describe the biased sample only.

at_k.caveat: Candidate lists are the labelled partners only, not all 131 other documents. Treat as a relative comparison between methods, not an absolute retrieval score.
